## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
\frac{\bar{X} - \mu}{\sigma / \sqrt{n}} \xrightarrow{d} \mathcal{N}(0,1)
$${#eq-clt}

Xi are i.i.d. random variables
μ=E[Xi]
σ2=Var(Xi)
Xb is the sample mean
d denotes convergence in distribution
N(0,1) is the standard normal distribution
